name: anim_wani_hugloop
subject: a huge muscular crocodile monster made of thick pink and yellow marbled liquid paint, its lower body melting into a puddle, hugging a small black witch cat
desc: Keeps squeezing and kneading the cat against its chest while the cat struggles and pushes against its arm; thick paint oozes and drips over the cat, squelching. Emphasize thick, sticky, viscous goo: paint stretching in strings, sagging, dripping and oozing with every movement.
